services.name: Kiln Rental
services.desc: This one-time pottery workshop is great for first-time potters - or those looking for a fun refresher. Students will learn the basics of throwing clay on the pottery wheel and make their own piece with oversight from our instructors. This is a fun and relaxing chance to unplug, get your hands muddy, and get creative. At the end of the workshop, students will choose from a selection of glazes and our team will take it from there. The turnaround for all pottery classes is 3-4 weeks. Our team will reach out when your piece is ready for pickup! This workshop is open to all levels- no experience necessary.
